generic_rule.description: For symbols not in explicit rename map, entity_id = provider asset ID if available and stable, else internal entity_id = canonical_symbol. Historical validity inferred from first/last observed bar and asset status, with PIT quality tier.
generic_rule.stable_id_preference: Alpaca asset ID (UUID) when demonstrated stable across asof queries; otherwise internal ID
generic_rule.double_count_test: Querying FB with asof 2022-06-01 and META with asof 2026-07-30 must not produce two separate entities with overlapping dates. Bars for FB_asof_before should be subset of META history, not duplicate same-date bars across aliases.
